tools.name: firewalk
tools.description_en: Active reconnaissance network security toolFirewalk is an active reconnaissance network security tool that attempts to determine what layer 4 protocols a given IP forwarding device will pass. It works by sending out TCP or UDP packets with a TTL one hop greater than the targeted gateway. If the gateway allows the traffic, it will forward the packets to the next hop where they will expire and elicit an ICMP_TIME_EXCEEDED message. Otherwise, it will likely drop the packets and there will be no response.
tools.description_zh: 主动侦察网络安全工具Firewalk是一种主动侦察网络安全工具，旨在确定特定IP转发设备将允许哪些第4层协议通过。其工作原理是发送TCP或UDP数据包，其TTL值比目标网关多一跳。如果网关允许该流量，它会将数据包转发到下一跳，在那里数据包将过期并引发ICMP_TIME_EXCEEDED消息。否则，它可能会丢弃这些数据包，从而不会有任何响应。

commands.description_zh: 扫描目标网关后主机8079到8081端口，判断防火墙规则是否放行TCP流量

tools.description_zh: 允许不同网络上的两台机器相互通信。放弃IP地址和端口号的概念，转而认为只要两个程序知道相同的密钥（而非彼此的IP地址和端口号），它们就应该能够相互通信。Global Socket库实现了这一点：它在本地生成临时会话密钥和ID，并通过Global Socket中继网络（GSRN）连接两个程序，无论本地IP地址或地理位置如何，均不受其影响。

tools.name: hyperion
tools.description_en: Runtime encrypter for 32-bit portable executablesThis package contains a runtime encrypter for 32-bit portable executables. It is a reference implementation and bases on the paper “: Implementation of a PE-Crypter”. The paper describes the implementation details which aren’t in the scope of this readme file. The crypter is started via the command line and encrypts an input executable with AES-128. The encrypted file decrypts itself on startup (bruteforcing the AES key which may take a few seconds) and generates a log file for debug purpose.
tools.description_zh: 32位可移植可执行文件的运行时加密器。本包包含一个针对32位可移植可执行文件的运行时加密器，作为参考实现，基于论文《PE-Crypter的实现》。论文详述了实现细节，不在本readme文件范围内。加密器通过命令行启动，使用AES-128加密输入的exe文件。加密后的文件在启动时自我解密（暴力破解AES密钥可能耗时几秒），并生成日志文件以供调试。

tools.name: iaxflood
tools.description_en: VoIP flooder toolA UDP Inter-Asterisk_eXchange (i.e. IAX) packet was captured from an IAX channel between two Asterisk IP PBX’s. The content of that packet is the source of the payload for the attack embodied by this tool. While the IAX protocol header might not match the Asterisk PBX you’ll attack with this tool, it may require more processing on the part of the PBX than a simple udpflood without any payload that even resembles an IAX payload.
tools.description_zh: VoIP洪水攻击工具。从两个Asterisk IP PBX之间的IAX通道捕获了一个UDP Inter-Asterisk_eXchange（即IAX）数据包。该数据包的内容构成了此工具所体现攻击的Payload来源。尽管IAX协议头部可能与你使用此工具攻击的Asterisk PBX不匹配，但相比没有任何类似IAX Payload的简单udpflood，它可能需要PBX进行更多处理。

commands.description_zh: 向目标192.168.1.202的IAX服务发送500个伪造呼叫，源地址伪装为192.168.1.1

tools.name: ifenslave
tools.description_en: Configure network interfaces for parallel routing (bonding)This is a tool to attach and detach slave network interfaces to a bonding device. A bonding device will act like a normal Ethernet network device to the kernel, but will send out the packets via the slave devices using a simple round-robin scheduler. This allows for simple load-balancing, identical to “channel bonding” or “trunking” techniques used in switches.
tools.description_zh: 配置网络接口以进行并行路由（绑定）这是一个用于将从属网络接口附加到绑定设备或从绑定设备分离的工具。绑定设备对内核而言将像普通以太网设备一样工作，但会使用简单的轮询调度器通过从属设备发送数据包。这允许实现简单的负载均衡，与交换机中使用的“通道绑定”或“链路聚合”技术相同。

tools.name: princeprocessor
tools.description_en: Standalone password candidate generator using the PRINCE algorithmPrinceprocessor is a password candidate generator and can be thought of as an advanced combinator attack. Rather than taking as input two different wordlists and then outputting all the possible two word combinations though, only has one input wordlist and builds “chains” of combined words. These chains can have 1 to N words from the input wordlist concatenated together. The name PRINCE is used as an acronym and stands for PRobability INfinite Chained Elements, which are the building blocks of the algorithm.
tools.description_zh: 使用PRINCE算法的独立密码候选生成器。Princeprocessor是一个密码候选生成器，可被视为一种高级组合攻击。它不像传统方式那样接收两个不同的单词列表并输出所有可能的双词组合，而是仅有一个输入单词列表，并构建组合单词的“链”。这些链可以包含从输入单词列表中串联起来的1到N个单词。PRINCE这个名字是一个首字母缩略词，代表PRobability INfinite Chained Elements，即算法的构建基础。

The project has a focus on providing tools for digital forensics investigations (though is useful for many purposes), and includes algorithms for retrieving deleted data structures from registry hives.
tools.description_zh: 用于分析基于Windows NT的注册表的实用工具（开发文件）是一个直接分析基于Windows NT的注册表文件的系统，提供命令行工具、C API和Python模块以访问注册表数据结构。该项目专注于为数字取证调查提供工具（尽管对许多用途都有用），并包含从注册表配置单元中恢复已删除数据结构的算法。

tools.name: regripper
tools.description_en: Perform forensic analysis of registry hivesRegripper’s CLI tool can be used to surgically extract, translate, and display information (both data and metadata) from Registry-formatted files via plugins in the form of Perl-scripts. It allows the analyst to select a hive-file to parse and a plugin or a profile, which is a list of plugins to run against the given hive. The results go to STDOUT and can be redirected to a file, that the analyst designates.
tools.description_zh: 对注册表配置单元进行取证分析。Regripper 的 CLI 工具可通过 Perl 脚本形式的插件，精准提取、转换并显示注册表格式文件中的信息（包括数据和元数据）。它允许分析人员选择要解析的配置单元文件以及一个插件或配置文件（即针对给定配置单元运行的一组插件）。结果输出到 STDOUT，并可重定向到分析人员指定的文件。

tools.name: yara
tools.description_en: Development libraries and headersYARA is a tool aimed at helping malware researchers to identify and classify malware samples. With YARA, it is possible to create descriptions of malware families based on textual or binary patterns contained in samples of those families. Each description consists of a set of strings and a Boolean expression which determines its logic.
tools.description_zh: 开发库和头文件YARA 是一款旨在帮助恶意软件研究人员识别和分类恶意软件样本的工具。借助 YARA，可以根据恶意软件家族样本中包含的文本或二进制模式，创建对这些家族的描述。每个描述由一组字符串和一个决定其逻辑的布尔表达式组成。

tools.name: yersinia
tools.description_en: Network vulnerabilities check softwareYersinia is a framework for performing layer 2 attacks. It is designed to take advantage of some weakeness in different network protocols. It pretends to be a solid framework for analyzing and testing the deployed networks and systems.
tools.description_zh: 网络漏洞检查软件。Yersinia 是一个执行第二层攻击的框架。它旨在利用不同网络协议中的一些弱点。它旨在成为一个用于分析和测试已部署网络和系统的可靠框架。

tools.name: zerofree
tools.description_en: Zero free blocks from ext2, ext3 and ext4 file-systemsZerofree finds the unallocated blocks with non-zero value content in an ext2, ext3 or ext4 file-system and fills them with zeroes ( can also work with another value than zero). This is mostly useful if the device on which this file-system resides is a disk image. In this case, depending on the type of disk image, a secondary utility may be able to reduce the size of the disk image after zerofree has been run. Zerofree requires the file-system to be unmounted or mounted read-only.
tools.description_zh: 从 ext2、ext3 和 ext4 文件系统中清零空闲块Zerofree 查找 ext2、ext3 或 ext4 文件系统中内容非零的未分配块，并用零填充它们（也可以使用零以外的其他值）。如果该文件系统所在的设备是磁盘映像，这通常很有用。在这种情况下，根据磁盘映像的类型，辅助工具可能能够在运行 zerofree 后缩小磁盘映像的大小。Zerofree 要求文件系统已卸载或以只读方式挂载。

tools.name: zonedb
tools.description_en: Public Zone Database (source library)This package provides a free, open-source database (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/) containing a list and associated metadata of public DNS zones (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DNS_zone) (domain name extensions). It attempts to be exhaustive, including current, retired, and withdrawn top-level domains and subdomains.
tools.description_zh: 公共区域数据库（源库）此软件包提供一个免费、开源的数据库（http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/），包含公共DNS区域（http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DNS_zone）（域名后缀）的列表及相关元数据。它力求详尽，包括当前、已退役和已撤销的顶级域及子域。

tools.name: zsh
tools.description_en: Shell with lots of featuresZsh is a UNIX command interpreter (shell) usable as an interactive login shell and as a shell script command processor. Of the standard shells, most closely resembles ksh but includes many enhancements. Zsh has command-line editing, built-in spelling correction, programmable command completion, shell functions (with autoloading), a history mechanism, and a host of other features.
tools.description_zh: 功能丰富的Shell。Zsh是一个UNIX命令解释器（shell），可用作交互式登录shell和shell脚本命令处理器。在标准shell中，它与ksh最为相似，但包含许多增强功能。Zsh具有命令行编辑、内置拼写纠正、可编程命令补全、shell函数（支持自动加载）、历史机制以及许多其他特性。

commands.description_zh: 显示 rzsh 命令帮助信息，rzsh 是受限模式 zsh，限制部分危险操作。
显示 zsh 命令帮助信息，列出可用选项和启动参数说明。

tools.name: zsh-autosuggestions
tools.description_en: Fish-like fast/unobtrusive autosuggestions for zshAs you type commands, you will see a completion offered after the cursor in a muted gray color. If you press the right-arrow key or End with the cursor at the end of the buffer, it will accept the suggestion, replacing the contents of the command line buffer with the suggestion. If you invoke the forward-word widget, it will partially accept the suggestion up to the point that the cursor moves to.
tools.description_zh: 类似 Fish 的 zsh 快速/无干扰自动建议。当你输入命令时，你会在光标后看到一个以柔和灰色显示的补全建议。如果光标位于缓冲区末尾时按下右箭头键或 End 键，它将接受该建议，用建议替换命令行缓冲区的内容。如果你调用 forward-word widget，它将部分接受建议，直到光标移动到的位置。

tools.name: zsh-syntax-highlighting
tools.description_en: Fish shell like syntax highlighting for zshThis package provides syntax highlighting for the shell zsh. It enables highlighting of commands whilst they are typed at a zsh prompt into an interactive terminal. This helps in reviewing commands before running them, particularly in catching syntax errors.
tools.description_zh: 为 zsh 提供类似 Fish shell 的语法高亮此软件包为 zsh shell 提供语法高亮功能。它能在交互式终端中，当用户在 zsh 提示符下输入命令时高亮显示这些命令。这有助于在执行命令前进行审查，特别是捕捉语法错误。
